rubric.role_summary: Senior product manager leading voice AI and audio-intelligence products for consumers and telecom operator partners, from product vision through hands-on development and execution.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior product manager leading voice AI and audio-intelligence products for consumers and telecom operator partners, from product vision through hands-on development and execution.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- At least one of: product management experience at a venture-backed startup; founder or early-employee experience at a startup with close involvement in the product; or MBB management consulting experience with demonstrable familiarity with technology.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Technical background through education or professional experience.
- Experience with AI or voice AI at the model, orchestration, or application layer.
- Previously launched successful products as a product manager.
- Has built something independently without an engineer.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: Greater Seattle area, Washington. Hybrid work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.

soft_requirements: Sense of urgency in execution and ability to encourage it in others.
Interest in building AI solutions for everyday communications.
Comfort with ambiguity, autonomy, and asking for help when needed.
Curiosity and willingness to learn and experiment quickly.
Uses AI in their way of working and stays engaged with new technology and AI developments.
Ownership, sound judgment about tradeoffs, and commitment to customer trust and quality.
